elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date
return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other data of the Company in HDI's possession or control

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format

elements.element: Return within 30 days of expiry or termination (not a later request)
elements.evidence: (b) within thirty (30) days of the Company's request, return to the Company all Content
(c) thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems
certify such deletion to the Company in writing
for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date
within thirty (30) days of the Company's request

reasons: The 30-day data return clock runs from "the Company's request" rather than from expiry or termination, so the mandatory post-termination return obligation is conditioned on a customer request and can be deferred indefinitely; this fails both the preferred and the fallback 30-day export requirement.
Fix: change (b) to "within thirty (30) days of expiration or termination of this Agreement" (keep the request condition, if at all, only in (a) for transition assistance).

Other preferred elements are satisfied: up to six months' assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return in a "commonly used, machine-readable format" (substantively the standard-format requirement), and deletion with written certification thereafter.
The insertion is a concise new Section 4.3 for an otherwise absent clause; it does not disturb the term, notice or Termination Payment mechanics and introduces no undefined terms.
